lines.lyric_hangul: 浮かび上がる君は
lines.lyric_translation: You, in my imagination

lines.lyric_hangul: あまりに鮮やかで Oh-oh
lines.lyric_translation: Are so vivid

lines.lyric: Marude soko ni iru ka to
lines.lyric_hangul: まるでそこにいるかと
lines.lyric_translation: As if you are right there

lines.lyric_hangul: 手を伸ばすところで
lines.lyric_translation: But I reach out my hand

lines.lyric_hangul: ふっと消えてしまう
lines.lyric_translation: And you suddenly disappear

lines.lyric: Tantanto furitsumotta kioku no naka de
lines.lyric_hangul: 淡々と降り積もった記憶の中で
lines.lyric_translation: From all the memories stored in my heart

lines.lyric: Kimi dake wo hiroi atsumete tsunagete
lines.lyric_hangul: 君だけを拾い集めて繋げて
lines.lyric_translation: I gather up the ones of you, link them together

lines.lyric_hangul: 部屋中に映して眺めながら
lines.lyric_translation: Gazing at them projected across the room
